name: shop attack (made up)
about: A made-up case with two planted contradictions (the FIR's weapon against the MLO's wound; Imran's two accounts of the night), one planted lead (a parcel that waited 19 days before reaching the laboratory) and one name-only mention that must not be merged.

documents.title: FIR 488/25
documents.text:
FIR 488/25, PS Gulberg. Registered 2023-03-02 03:15.
Incident: 1 March 2023 at about 22:00, outside Asif General Store, Main Boulevard, Gulberg.
Complainant Asif s/o Rafiq states: Kamran s/o Aslam fired at my brother Naveed with a pistol.
Accused: Kamran s/o Aslam; Imran s/o Rashid. DNA report of the blood-stained cloth is awaited.

documents.title: Medico-legal report of Naveed
documents.text:
Medico-legal report of Naveed s/o Rafiq, examined 2023-03-01 23:40.
Injury 1: incised wound 4 x 1 cm on the right thigh, caused by a sharp-edged weapon. No firearm injury noted.
Parcel P-1 (blood-stained cloth) collected on 2023-03-02. Parcel P-1 sent to the laboratory on 2023-03-21.

documents.title: 161 statement of Imran
documents.text: Statement under section 161 of Imran s/o Rashid, recorded 2023-03-06 by SI Zahid: Main saari raat ghar par tha.

documents.title: Supplementary statement of Imran
documents.text: Supplementary statement of Imran s/o Rashid, recorded 2023-03-10 by SI Zahid: Main raat 8 baje tak dukaan par tha, phir ghar gaya.

facts.statement: FIR 488/25 names Kamran Aslam as the accused who fired
facts.quote: Kamran s/o Aslam fired at my brother
